outdoor.restriction: Shaded, ventilated protective base, raised >=15mm, no vegetation/soil touching fins. Avoid severe obstruction; continuous beacon requires its measured role-specific thermal envelope.
outdoor.fire_safety: No ignition-temperature or outdoor/fire qualification claim; case/guard solar temperature requires measurement independently of transmitter dissipation

stress_disposition: Legacy4/4.24/1.1W allowances are imposed independent stresses. Fault interruption latency is unmeasured; sensor cannot protect rapid PA local faults. Initial powered qualification requires bounded pulses and an instrumented dummy load, not an automatic30s test entitlement.
